{"schema_version":1,"rules":[
{"id":"port.docker_api.exposed","version":1,"title":"Docker API is exposed","severity":"critical","confidence":90,"expression":"'2375' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"The unencrypted Docker API (tcp 2375) listens on a non-loopback address; anyone who reaches it controls the host. Bind it to a Unix socket or loopback, or use TLS on 2376.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0002","technique":"T1609"},{"tactic":"TA0004","technique":"T1611"}]},
{"id":"port.kubelet.exposed","version":1,"title":"Kubernetes kubelet API is exposed","severity":"critical","confidence":90,"expression":"'10250' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"The Kubernetes kubelet API (tcp 10250) listens on a non-loopback address; with anonymous auth on, anyone who reaches it can run commands in pods. Disable anonymous auth and firewall it to the control plane.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0002","technique":"T1609"},{"tactic":"TA0004","technique":"T1611"}]},
{"id":"port.etcd.exposed","version":1,"title":"etcd is exposed","severity":"critical","confidence":90,"expression":"'2379' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"etcd (tcp 2379) listens on a non-loopback address; without client certificates it gives full read and write access, including Kubernetes secrets. Require client TLS and firewall it to its peers.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0006","technique":"T1552.007"},{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.ollama.exposed","version":1,"title":"Ollama API is exposed","severity":"critical","confidence":90,"expression":"'11434' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"The Ollama API (tcp 11434) listens on a non-loopback address; it has no authentication, so anyone who reaches it can pull, delete and run models. Bind it to loopback (OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1), or put an authenticating proxy in front.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"},{"tactic":"TA0040","technique":"T1496"}]},
{"id":"port.telnet.exposed","version":1,"title":"Telnet is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'23' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"Telnet (tcp 23) listens on a non-loopback address; it sends passwords in clear text. Disable it and use SSH.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1133"},{"tactic":"TA0006","technique":"T1040"}]},
{"id":"port.rsh.exposed","version":1,"title":"rsh/rlogin/rexec is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'512' in facts['port.tcp.exposed'] || '513' in facts['port.tcp.exposed'] || '514' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"rexec, rlogin or rsh (tcp 512-514) listens on a non-loopback address; these trust host names and send credentials in clear text. Disable them and use SSH.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1133"},{"tactic":"TA0006","technique":"T1040"}]},
{"id":"port.vnc.exposed","version":1,"title":"VNC is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'5900' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"VNC (tcp 5900) listens on a non-loopback address; it is often weakly authenticated and unencrypted. Bind it to loopback and tunnel it over SSH, or firewall it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1133"},{"tactic":"TA0008","technique":"T1021.005"}]},
{"id":"port.redis.exposed","version":1,"title":"Redis is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'6379' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"Redis (tcp 6379) listens on a non-loopback address; by default it has no password and can be used to write files. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it and require authentication.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.mongodb.exposed","version":1,"title":"MongoDB is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'27017' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"MongoDB (tcp 27017) listens on a non-loopback address. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it and enable authentication.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.elasticsearch.exposed","version":1,"title":"Elasticsearch is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'9200' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"Elasticsearch (tcp 9200) listens on a non-loopback address. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it and enable security.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.memcached.exposed","version":1,"title":"memcached is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'11211' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"memcached (tcp 11211) listens on a non-loopback address; it has no authentication and can leak cached data. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.zookeeper.exposed","version":1,"title":"ZooKeeper is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'2181' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"ZooKeeper (tcp 2181) listens on a non-loopback address; by default it has no authentication. Firewall it to the cluster, and enable SASL or TLS.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.kafka.exposed","version":1,"title":"Kafka is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'9092' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"Kafka (tcp 9092) listens on a non-loopback address; the default listener is plaintext with no authentication. Firewall it to its clients, and enable SASL and TLS.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.couchdb.exposed","version":1,"title":"CouchDB is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'5984' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"CouchDB (tcp 5984) listens on a non-loopback address. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it and make sure an admin password is set.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.cassandra.exposed","version":1,"title":"Cassandra is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'9042' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"Cassandra (tcp 9042) listens on a non-loopback address; its default authenticator allows everyone. Firewall it to its clients, and enable PasswordAuthenticator.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.consul.exposed","version":1,"title":"Consul HTTP API is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'8500' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"The Consul HTTP API (tcp 8500) listens on a non-loopback address; without ACLs it can register services that run commands. Bind it to loopback, or enable ACLs and firewall it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.rabbitmq_management.exposed","version":1,"title":"RabbitMQ management is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'15672' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"The RabbitMQ management interface (tcp 15672) listens on a non-loopback address. Firewall it to administrators, and remove the default guest user.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.influxdb.exposed","version":1,"title":"InfluxDB is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'8086' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"InfluxDB (tcp 8086) listens on a non-loopback address; version 1 has no authentication by default. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it and enable authentication.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.mssql.exposed","version":1,"title":"Microsoft SQL Server is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'1433' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"Microsoft SQL Server (tcp 1433) listens on a non-loopback address; it is a common brute-force target. Firewall it to the hosts that need it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.oracle.exposed","version":1,"title":"Oracle database listener is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'1521' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"The Oracle database listener (tcp 1521) listens on a non-loopback address. Firewall it to the hosts that need it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.x11.exposed","version":1,"title":"X11 is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'6000' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"An X server (tcp 6000) listens on a non-loopback address; a client that is let in can read keystrokes and the screen. Start the X server with -nolisten tcp, and forward X over SSH.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0009","technique":"T1056.001"},{"tactic":"TA0009","technique":"T1113"}]},
{"id":"port.rpcbind.exposed","version":1,"title":"rpcbind is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'111' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"rpcbind (tcp 111) listens on a non-loopback address; it lists RPC services and is used in reflection attacks. Disable it if no NFS v3 or NIS is served, or firewall it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0007","technique":"T1046"}]},
{"id":"port.nfs.exposed","version":1,"title":"NFS is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'2049' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"NFS (tcp 2049) listens on a non-loopback address. Export only to the hosts that need it, and firewall it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0009","technique":"T1039"}]},
{"id":"port.tftp.exposed","version":1,"title":"TFTP is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'69' in facts['port.udp.exposed']","finding_message":"TFTP (udp 69) listens on a non-loopback address; it has no authentication. Disable it, or firewall it to the boot network.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0011","technique":"T1105"}]},
{"id":"port.ftp.exposed","version":1,"title":"FTP is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'21' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"FTP (tcp 21) listens on a non-loopback address; it sends passwords in clear text. Use SFTP, or firewall it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"},{"tactic":"TA0006","technique":"T1040"}]},
{"id":"port.smb.exposed","version":1,"title":"SMB is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'139' in facts['port.tcp.exposed'] || '445' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"SMB (tcp 139 or 445) listens on a non-loopback address. Firewall it to the networks that need file sharing.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0008","technique":"T1021.002"},{"tactic":"TA0009","technique":"T1039"}]},
{"id":"port.snmp.exposed","version":1,"title":"SNMP is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'161' in facts['port.udp.exposed']","finding_message":"SNMP (udp 161) listens on a non-loopback address; v1/v2c community strings are sent in clear text. Firewall it, or use SNMPv3.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0009","technique":"T1602.001"}]},
{"id":"port.postgresql.exposed","version":1,"title":"PostgreSQL is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'5432' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"PostgreSQL (tcp 5432) listens on a non-loopback address. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it to the hosts that need it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.mysql.exposed","version":1,"title":"MySQL is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'3306' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"MySQL or MariaDB (tcp 3306) listens on a non-loopback address. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it to the hosts that need it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.ldap.exposed","version":1,"title":"Cleartext LDAP is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'389' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"LDAP (tcp 389) listens on a non-loopback address; binds without StartTLS send passwords in clear text. Require StartTLS or use LDAPS on 636, and firewall it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"},{"tactic":"TA0006","technique":"T1040"}]},
{"id":"port.kibana.exposed","version":1,"title":"Kibana is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'5601' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"Kibana (tcp 5601) listens on a non-loopback address. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it and enable security.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1190"}]},
{"id":"port.rdp.exposed","version":1,"title":"RDP is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'3389' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"RDP (tcp 3389) listens on a non-loopback address; it is a common brute-force target. Firewall it, require Network Level Authentication, or reach it through a VPN.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1133"},{"tactic":"TA0008","technique":"T1021.001"}]},
{"id":"port.winrm.exposed","version":1,"title":"WinRM over HTTP is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'5985' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"WinRM over HTTP (tcp 5985) listens on a non-loopback address. Firewall it to administrators, or use HTTPS on 5986.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1133"},{"tactic":"TA0008","technique":"T1021.006"}]},
{"id":"port.ssh.exposed","version":1,"title":"SSH is exposed","severity":"low","confidence":90,"expression":"'22' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"SSH (tcp 22) listens on a non-loopback address. If the host is reachable from untrusted networks, allow keys only and firewall it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1133"},{"tactic":"TA0008","technique":"T1021.004"}]},
{"id":"port.node_exporter.exposed","version":1,"title":"Prometheus node_exporter is exposed","severity":"low","confidence":90,"expression":"'9100' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"Prometheus node_exporter (tcp 9100) listens on a non-loopback address; it shows host details to anyone who reaches it. Firewall it to the Prometheus server.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0007","technique":"T1082"}]},
{"id":"package.telnet_server.installed","version":2,"title":"Telnet server is installed","severity":"low","confidence":100,"expression":"'inetutils-telnetd' in facts['package.names'] || 'telnet-server' in facts['package.names'] || 'telnetd' in facts['package.names']","finding_message":"A telnet server package is installed. Remove it and use SSH.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1133"}]},
{"id":"package.rsh_server.installed","version":2,"title":"rsh server is installed","severity":"low","confidence":100,"expression":"'rsh-redone-server' in facts['package.names'] || 'rsh-server' in facts['package.names']","finding_message":"An rsh server package is installed. Remove it and use SSH.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1133"}]},
{"id":"package.nis_server.installed","version":1,"title":"NIS server is installed","severity":"low","confidence":100,"expression":"'nis' in facts['package.names'] || 'ypserv' in facts['package.names']","finding_message":"A NIS server package (ypserv or nis) is installed; NIS sends password hashes to any client that asks. Remove it and use LDAP or local accounts.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0006","technique":"T1003.008"}]},
{"id":"package.tftp_server.installed","version":1,"title":"TFTP server is installed","severity":"low","confidence":100,"expression":"'atftpd' in facts['package.names'] || 'tftp-server' in facts['package.names'] || 'tftpd' in facts['package.names'] || 'tftpd-hpa' in facts['package.names']","finding_message":"A TFTP server package is installed; TFTP has no authentication. Remove it unless the host serves network boot.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0011","technique":"T1105"}]},
{"id":"package.xinetd.installed","version":1,"title":"xinetd is installed","severity":"low","confidence":100,"expression":"'xinetd' in facts['package.names']","finding_message":"The xinetd package is installed; it is mostly used to run legacy cleartext services. Remove it and run what is needed as systemd services.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1133"}]},
{"id":"package.talk_server.installed","version":1,"title":"talk server is installed","severity":"low","confidence":100,"expression":"'inetutils-talkd' in facts['package.names'] || 'talk-server' in facts['package.names'] || 'talkd' in facts['package.names']","finding_message":"A talk server package is installed; talk is an unencrypted legacy service. Remove it.","attack":[{"tactic":"TA0001","technique":"T1133"}]},
{"id":"test.openvibes.running","version":1,"title":"OpenVIBES test program is running","severity":"info","confidence":100,"expression":"'openvibes-test' in facts['process.names']","finding_message":"The OpenVIBES test program (openvibes-test finding) is running; findings work on this host. Stop it with Ctrl-C."}
]}
